summary.enrich_hint: Looks up missing abstracts, DOIs and PMIDs in an open scholarly metadata database. Only fills empty fields.

import.title: Import a search file
import.file_hint: RIS, PubMed (.nbib or XML), BibTeX, Web of Science (.txt) or CSV. Up to 50 MB.
import.query_hint: Paste the string exactly as used. It goes into the methods report.
import.delete_confirm: Delete this search and the {{count}} references imported from it? This cannot be undone.
import.mismatch: The database reported {{reported}} results, but the file had {{imported}}.

records.search: Search title, abstract, authors, journal or DOI

dups.explain: Choose which record stays. The others count as removed duplicates. Highlighted fields differ between records.

screening.blind_on: Blinding on: nobody sees the others' decisions.
screening.blind_off: Blinding off: decisions are visible to the team.
screening.kappa_hint: Cohen's kappa: above 0.6 is considered good; above 0.8, excellent.
screening.no_pairs: No records have been rated by two people yet.
screening.done_title: Nothing left to screen for now.
screening.done_body: New records or freed slots will show up here.
screening.reasons_hint: Use the number keys to pick and Enter to confirm.
screening.shortcuts: Shortcuts: I include · E exclude · M maybe · ← previous · → skip · U undo
screening.blind_conflicts: Turn blinding off in Protocol to see and resolve conflicts.
screening.not_reviewer: Your role in this project does not include screening.

protocol.title: Screening protocol
protocol.blind_hint: Each reviewer only sees their own decisions. Turn off to resolve conflicts.
protocol.hl_hint: One per line. Add * at the end for variants (random* matches randomized and randomised).
protocol.readonly: Only leads can change the protocol.

prisma.title: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
prisma.hint: Updated from the screening decisions. Download as SVG to edit or PNG to paste into a paper.
prisma.pending_note_one: {{count}} record without a final decision is not counted in the boxes.
prisma.pending_note_other: {{count}} records without a final decision are not counted in the boxes.

export.title: Export references
export.hint: Includes each record's state, exclusion reasons and labels. With blinding on, you only get your own decisions.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.intro: Register the AI services ReValli can use. It works with Ollama on this server or with remote APIs that follow the OpenAI-compatible chat format.
ai.name: Name
ai.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ai.api_key_keep: Current: {{hint}}. Leave blank to keep it.
ai.is_local_hint: Projects marked “local only” only use local providers.
ai.model_hint: Exact model name at the provider (use “Test” to see the list).
ai.task_screening_hint: Reads title and abstract and suggests include, exclude or maybe.
ai.task_embeddings_hint: Turns abstracts into vectors to sort the queue by likely relevance.
ai.not_configured: No screening model is configured on this installation.
ai.enabled_hint: Nothing is sent to any model while this is off.
ai.local_only_hint: Project data never leaves the server. Remote providers are blocked.
ai.mode_suggest_hint: The AI does not vote. Each reviewer sees its suggestion only after deciding, to avoid anchoring.
ai.mode_second_reviewer_hint: The AI takes one reviewer slot on each record. Disagreements become conflicts for a human to resolve.
ai.budget_hint: The run stops when the next request would exceed the limit. Empty = no limit.
ai.extra_hint: Optional. E.g. “Studies in children must be excluded.”
ai.scope_pending_hint: Records without a complete decision in this phase.
ai.scope_excluded_hint: Records the humans excluded. The AI points out the ones that may deserve a second look.
ai.scope_calibration_hint: A sample of records already decided by humans, to measure how well the AI does before trusting it.
ai.estimate_cost: Estimated cost: {{cost}}. Already spent on the project: {{spent}}.
ai.started: Run started. Progress shows at the top of the page.
ai.calibration_hint: Compares the AI answers with the human decisions. “Maybe” counts as include, since it does not drop the study.
ai.sensitivity_hint: Of the studies humans included, how many the AI also included.
ai.specificity_hint: Of the studies humans excluded, how many the AI also excluded.
ai.confusion: Included by both: {{tp}} · AI excluded an included one: {{fn}} · Excluded by both: {{tn}} · AI included an excluded one: {{fp}} · “Maybe” answers: {{maybe}}
ai.low_recall: Sensitivity is below 95%. Review the criteria or use the AI only as a suggestion.
ai.no_calibration: No AI answers for human-decided records yet. Run a calibration.
ai.flags_title: Excluded records the AI would include
ai.flags_hint: Records the team excluded where the AI disagreed. Worth a check.
ai.usage: AI usage on this project: {{calls}} calls, {{tokens}} tokens, {{cost}}.
